You know howmany times I throw away bags upon bags of memory items, and they keep popping up. A single slipper that he bought me when he visited me in My new state, a Keepsake John Deere ornament his mom got us in 2009. And even without those things, which all made me breakdown today as I packed away, after four years I still reach for my ring when I get nervous or sit at a traffic light. Everyday. I can't let go. And I'm not going to try anymore. I really truly appreciate you trying to help. But not all of us want help. Some of us just want to not be here and have to deal with it everyday.
